headline: Altair Chemicals announces layoffs affecting 18% of workforce
body: Altair Chemicals said it will cut 18% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Altair Chemicals reports record quarterly revenue
body: Altair Chemicals reported revenue growth of 25% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Altair Chemicals wins quality award from industry association
body: Altair Chemicals received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Altair Chemicals announces layoffs affecting 22% of workforce
body: Altair Chemicals said it will cut 22% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Altair Chemicals opens new production line in Windsor
body: Altair Chemicals commissioned a new line at its Windsor site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Altair Chemicals publishes annual sustainability report
body: Altair Chemicals released its annual sustainability report covering energy use and waste reduction targets. The report was prepared in line with standard reporting guidelines.

headline: Altair Chemicals announces layoffs affecting 16% of workforce
body: Altair Chemicals said it will cut 16% of its workforce as part of a cost reduction program. Unions criticized the lack of consultation.

headline: Altair Chemicals faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Altair Chemicals. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.
